milestone: Changed-file discovery to existing pinned comparison

independence.producerReads: No new changed-files producer source or tests read. Read approved design, existing native fixture/comparison harness, and existing comparison missing-source representation only.
independence.expectedMetadata: Explicit original path/change/kind/mode/absence facts. SHA1 Git blob IDs independently calculated from literal blob header and original bytes. Full commit IDs acquired only from author-created temporary fixture commits.
independence.expectedComparison: Original content/counts, explicit present/missing status and complete immutable IDs, plus actual downloaded JSON/HTML exact equality with actual CLI using same explicit pins. CLI parity is supplementary to literal facts.
independence.fixtureExecution: No temporary repository, service or browser started by author. Runtime fixture uses only base-owned mkdtemp repository and ephemeral authenticated loopback server.

fixtureGitlinkPlaceholderExplanation: Illustrative placeholders replaced only by original fixture commit IDs at runtime; no Git invocation performed.

privacy: Launch fragment capability remains local fixture memory only. Download assertions exclude capability and absolute repo path.

coverageLimits: No simultaneous maximum10k/count/raw2MiB/JSON8MiB assertion; separate domain/max owners cover limits.
